# B1.1 — Cost-Aware Artwork Identification: Spike Findings & Recommendation

**Goal (decision D):** identify artworks favoring local/free resources over paid APIs.
Identification feeds two needs: genre-aware **cropping** (needs artist/genre/style) and the
museum **placard** (needs accurate title/artist/date).

## Empirical findings (measured locally)

| Approach | Cost | Latency | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| **qwen3-vl:8b** (Ollama, local VLM) | free | ~19 s/img | Artist ✓, style ✓, genre ✓; **title/date hallucinated** (claims "high" confidence even when wrong). Gauguin *Field of Derout-Lollichon* (1886): artist/style/genre correct, but title→"The House of the Sun", date→1892. |
| **CLIP clip-ViT-B-32** (sentence-transformers, local) | free | ~44 s first load, ms/img after | 512-dim embeddings; self-sim 1.0, cross-image 0.66 — discriminates. Suitable for catalog similarity. |
| **Qdrant** (local, :6333) | free | — | Available for the artwork catalog. |
| Reverse-image API (SerpAPI / TinEye) | paid (~$50/mo) | — | Deferred; optional confirmation signal only. |

## Key insight
The local VLM is **reliable for artist / genre / style** (which drives the genre-aware crop —
the project's core asset) but **unreliable for exact title / date** (which the placard needs).
This matches comparative research (doc `05` §1): VLM attribution hallucinates. A retrieval
cross-check is the single highest-leverage reliability improvement.

## Recommended strategy — $0 on the common path
1. **Stage 1 — local VLM (`qwen3-vl`)**: artist, genre, style + *candidate* title/date.
   Genre/style feed cropping immediately, for free.
2. **Stage 2 — local CLIP + Qdrant catalog cross-check**: embed the artwork, find nearest
   known works. High-confidence match (cosine ≥ threshold, ~0.90) → adopt its **verified**
   title/artist/date (corrects the VLM). No confident match → keep VLM hypothesis but **flag**
   title/date as low-confidence (agree-or-flag).
3. **Stage 3 — paid reverse-image (default OFF, config-gated)**: only on a catalog miss when
   exact attribution matters and the cost is accepted.

## Feeds the rest of B1
- **B1.2** — build the local CLIP+Qdrant catalog: Qdrant collection `neural_canvas_artworks`
  (512-dim, cosine), seeded from public-domain art + the project corpus; embed with
  `clip-ViT-B-32`.
- **B1.3** — wire VLM-hypothesis + catalog cross-check (agree-or-flag) into `ResearchAgent`.

## Config (already in `config.example.yaml` → `identification:`)
`engine: local_first` · `vision_model: qwen3-vl:8b` · `catalog_enabled: true` ·
`reverse_image_api: ""` (off). Cost stays at $0 unless the paid stage is explicitly enabled.
